name: Indie Hustles

sources.title: Submit Your Product — form with Free $0 (8-10 week queue) vs Priority $9 (48h)
Homepage — indie alternatives to popular SaaS

conditions: Free tier exists but carries a stated 8-10 week review queue
requirements: Product should be an indie-built alternative to a popular SaaS — listings are displayed as 'X alternative to [popular tools]'
Categories: AI, Analytics, CRM, Design Tools, Dev Tools, Email, Forms, Marketing, Productivity, Project Management, Website Builder, Other
preparation: Submitter name, email, and Twitter/X handle (shown on the product's founder card)
Product name, website URL, category, tagline
Comma-separated list of popular alternatives the product replaces (e.g. 'Mailchimp, Sendgrid, Brevo')
Logo (products display with a logo on cards)
workflow: Fill Your Information (name, email, X handle) and Product Information (name, website, category, tagline, popular alternatives)
Choose plan: Free $0 (8-10 week standard queue) or Priority $9 (48h review)
Submit — 'Submit & Pay $9' when Priority is selected
watchFor: 8-10 weeks is an unusually long free queue — the $9 priority upsell is the intended nudge
The submit button label changes to 'Submit & Pay $9' when Priority is chosen — verify the selected plan before clicking
Twitter/X handle is public-facing on the founder card
countsAsLive: Product has a page under indiehustles.com/product/<uuid> and appears in the alternatives grid
unknowns: Whether free-tier submissions are ever rejected rather than just queued
